content.title: TRADISI ADAT MERARIQ MEMULANG DI DESA BAYAN BELEQ

results:
Search results on the Sasak *merariq* marriage custom in Lombok are consistent on the basic practice but differ in detail by region.

**Basic meaning:** The term originally referred to an elopement in which a man takes a woman he wants to marry, and it now covers the whole Sasak customary marriage sequence. Awalnya, merariq hanya merupakan istilah untuk sebuah tindakan membawa lari seorang gadis dengan maksud untuk menikahinya. Akan tetapi, istilah merariq sekarang digunakan untuk menyebut seluruh rangkaian perkawinan adat Sasak.

**Stages:** One Islamic-law-oriented study lists the sequence as Pemidangan, Beseboq, Selabar, Sejati, Sorong Serah. The commonly cited general rules include that the bride is taken from her parents' home, not from elsewhere, and that the abduction should happen at night, after the Maghrib prayer until about 23:00 WITA, since daytime abduction is considered shameful. The rules also require courteous conduct and no force (7-4 to 7-7).

**Regional variation:** A 2024 study of Desa Bayan Beleq in North Lombok found that this procession includes two parallel tracks, religious marriage and customary marriage, with stages including a symbolic abduction, a three-night hiding period, a series of customary rituals such as muding jerepet, kikir gigi, and Nobat Lekok Buak, and finally a menjango procession in place of the nyongkolan. The same study notes that most Sasak communities have undergone significant simplification in the stages of the merariq procession.

**Caste restriction:** There is a restriction on noble women, under which Sasak women may not marry men who do not come from noble families. This status-based restriction still persists in some areas of Lombok.

Sources differ on origins: some argue merariq is an original Sasak custom, while others see it as shaped by acculturation (6-7 to 6-11). The search results were mainly academic articles, and the procedural details above come from secondary descriptions rather than a single authoritative source.

content.text:
**答案:** Merariq 指的是萨萨克族(Sasak)的“带走新娘”式婚俗程序。男方在夜里把想娶的女子从她父母家中带走(私奔式的象征性“抢婚”),再按习俗完成后续的婚礼仪式。

- **本义与现义**:最初 merariq 只指把姑娘带走、以便娶她的行为,现在则泛指整套萨萨克传统婚姻程序。
- **常见规则**:要从女方父母家带走,通常在日落祷告(Maghrib)后到约 23:00 之间进行,白天带人被视为不体面。过程要守礼,不能使用暴力。
- **一种研究列出的阶段**:Pemidangan、Beseboq、Selabar、Sejati、Sorong Serah。
- **地区差异**:2024 年对北龙目岛 Bayan Beleq 村的研究显示,那里的程序更复杂,包括象征性带走、躲藏三晚和一系列习俗仪式,最后以 menjango 取代 nyongkolan。多数萨萨克社区已经简化了这些阶段。

我搜到的主要是学术论文,上面的细节来自二手描述,不是单一权威来源,各地做法也不完全一致。

Sources:
- [TRADISI ADAT MERARIQ MEMULANG DI DESA BAYAN BELEQ](https://jurnalfkip.unram.ac.id/index.php/SocEd/article/view/9794)
- [jurnalfkip.unram.ac.id(同一篇的 PDF)](https://jurnalfkip.unram.ac.id/index.php/SocEd/article/download/9794/7369/81050)
- [journal.uinmataram.ac.id(Qawwam)](https://journal.uinmataram.ac.id/index.php/qawwam/article/download/7028/2487/19590)
- [risalah.unram.ac.id](https://risalah.unram.ac.id/index.php/risalah/article/download/131/107)
